title: Electuary

inlines.v: ELEC'TUARY, noun [Low Latin electarium, electuarium; Gr. to lick.] In pharmacy, a form of medicine composed of powders, or other ingredients, incorporated with some conserve, honey or syrup, and made into due consistence, to be taken in doses, like boluses.
